title: CertiK Partners with Arbitrum and Robinhood Crypto to Support Web3 Startups
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – New York, New York, October 30th, 2026] CertiK has partnered with Arbitrum and Robinhood Crypto through the Arbitrum Mentorship Program, an initiative designed to help early-stage Web3 teams turn promising ideas into successful products.
